Machine-readable copy: https://a-11-oy.com/.well-known/x402-pricing.json. 4 of 17 gateway rules enabled (a-11-oy.com: 4 of 15; a11oy.net: 0 of 2), per the fresh Cloudflare Monetization Gateway rules readback of 2026-11-11 at 16:40 UTC.

Limits: Methods: the rules export records no HTTP method selection, and Cloudflare's documented default charges GET only, so whether POST requests to these paths are charged is unverified. Origins: paying clears the gateway only; whether each origin then serves a paid caller without its own credential has not been verified. Eligibility: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway requires buyers and sellers to be based in the United States. Revenue: this catalog records prices, not settlements; it says nothing about whether any payment has settled.
